comment.body:
I removed HMAC, ECDSA, and RSA-PSS signature support, they aren't used in Mastodon or GoToSocial.

I'd recommend removing RSA-v1.5-2048 support as well, but there may be desire to interop with fediverse instances that only support RFC-9421 w/ RSA-v1.5-2048.

Also, we should consider vendoring the [yaronf/httpsign](https://github.com/yaronf/httpsign) dependency. There is a bug for one of the required pseudo-elements used to create/verify signatures, and the library includes a large amount of LLM contributions. I'd recommend forking from the last release prior to LLM contributions, and applying the necessary patches to fix the bug.

Updating to the latest `yaronf/httpsign` dep is also not possible due to the dependency on an incompatible toolchain version.

body.content: ["10206","I removed the ECDSA + RSA-PSS signature support, they aren't used in Mastodon or GoToSocial.\r"]
